game.blurb: Remake of the 2013 pirate action-adventure from Ubisoft, released 2026-07-09. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. RAWG lists it with a typo as "Assassin's Creed Back Flag Resynced" (slug assassins-creed-back-flag-resynced). No StrategyWiki page, and no page under this title on assassinscreed.fandom.com; marked unverified, not retried. The Steam schema calls the app "OBSIDIAN" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 3751950. 7 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden.
